description: Source code implementing TLS credential management using PSA Protected Storage API, including credential storage, retrieval, deletion, and synchronization with a credentials table of content.

methods.name: tls_credential_get_uid
methods.description: Constructs a PSA storage UID from a tag and type.

methods.name: tls_credential_uid_to_tag
methods.description: Extracts the tag from a UID.

methods.name: tls_credential_uid_to_type
methods.description: Extracts the type from a UID.

methods.name: credentials_toc_get
methods.description: Retrieves the credentials table of content from PSA storage.

methods.name: credentials_toc_write
methods.description: Writes the credentials table of content to PSA storage.

methods.name: credentials_toc_update
methods.description: Updates a specific slot in the credentials table of content.

methods.name: tls_credential_toc_find_slot
methods.description: Finds the slot index of a given UID in the credentials table.

methods.name: credentials_init
methods.description: Initializes credentials from PSA storage, validating and syncing the table of content.

methods.name: credential_get_from_uid
methods.description: Retrieves a credential structure from a UID.

methods.name: credential_get
methods.description: Retrieves a credential by tag and type.

methods.name: credential_next_get
methods.description: Finds the next credential matching a tag after a given credential.

methods.name: credential_next_tag_get
methods.description: Finds the next tag greater than a given tag.

methods.name: credential_digest
methods.description: Calculates the digest of a credential.

methods.name: tls_credential_add
methods.description: Adds a new credential to PSA storage and updates the table of content.

methods.name: tls_credential_get
methods.description: Retrieves a credential from PSA storage by tag and type.

methods.name: tls_credential_delete
methods.description: Deletes a credential from PSA storage and updates the table of content.
